common.upToDate: Up to date with the market calendar.
common.behind: {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} behind the market calendar. The next update may be late.

locked.title: Part of the {tier} tier
locked.body: This information is included in the {tier} tier and above. Accounts and subscriptions are not open yet.
locked.preview: Free preview, shown with a {days}-day delay: data to {date}. Current values are part of the {tier} tier.

home.title: Markets overview
home.intro: Daily figures for the Colombo Stock Exchange and LKR government bonds, computed from public sources, with every method explained.

cse.title: Stock market
cse.intro: The Colombo Stock Exchange's session in numbers: indices, activity, foreign flows and breadth.
cse.headline: Headline indices
cse.averagePending: 20-session average available after {count, plural, one {# more session} other {# more sessions}}
cse.valuation: Market valuation (as published by the CSE)
cse.breadthNote: Ordinary voting and non-voting shares that traded, against their previous close.
cse.moversNote: Among shares with turnover of at least Rs 1 mn this session.

shares.title: Shares
shares.intro: Every share's latest session. Prices are as published and are not adjusted for splits, bonuses or rights; a flag marks where that matters.
shares.rangePosHelp: Where the close sits between the 52-week low (0%) and high (100%) the CSE publishes.
shares.relHelp: Price return minus the ASPI's return over 5, 21 and 63 sessions.
shares.flagJump: A move of more than 40% in one session inside this window: probably a corporate action the prices are not adjusted for.
shares.flagNoTrade: No trade before the start of this window.
shares.flagRange: A move of more than 40% in one session within the last year: the 52-week range may not be comparable.

share.beta: Beta against the ASPI (as published by the CSE)

bonds.title: Government bonds
bonds.intro: LKR treasury bonds: the dealers' daily quotes, a yield curve fitted to them, and how actively each bond trades.
bonds.curveNote: A Nelson-Siegel curve fitted to the dealers' average quotes, each weighted by how tight its bid-offer spread is. Trades are not used in the fit; they show where business was done.
bonds.fitStats: {n} quotes; fit error {rmse} bp. {trades, plural, =0 {No trades checked yet} one {Checked against # traded bond} other {Checked against # traded bonds}}.
bonds.tradeBias: Trades printed {bias} bp from the curve (median).
bonds.tableNote: Residual: the quoted mid minus the curve, in basis points. Positive means the bond's quoted yield is above the curve.
bonds.oneWay: one-way quote: not in the fit
bonds.tierHelp: Benchmark: auctioned in the last 120 days and traded on at least 8 of the last 60 days. Active: traded on at least 10 of the last 60 days. Less traded: quoted but traded less often.
bonds.wideQuotes: Wide or administered quotes (little weight in the fit)
bonds.wideQuote: wide quote: little weight in the fit

bond.label: Series
bond.synthetic: No PDMO release names this bond with an ISIN; it is identified by its maturity and coupon.

zscores.title: Residuals against their own history
zscores.intro: Each bond's distance from the curve, compared with that bond's own previous 60 observations. A z-score of +2 means the residual is two standard deviations above its own recent average. This describes the data; it is not a forecast.
zscores.pairsNote: The residual spread between this bond and each bond of similar maturity (or, for two auctioned bonds, any maturity), against its own history. Choose another bond in the table above.
zscores.pairsNone: No pair with enough common history on this date.

execution.title: Trades against quotes
execution.intro: Where executed trades printed relative to the dealers' quoted mid, as a 20-day median. Positive: trades at higher yields (lower prices) than the quotes.

carry.title: Carry, rolldown and duration
carry.intro: What each bond's yield earns over a stated funding rate, plus rolldown along an unchanged curve, per year and per year of duration. The funding rate is the 12-month treasury bill plus 5 bp; your own funding cost will differ.

methods.title: Methods
methods.intro: Every number on this site comes from one of these models. Each page states the method, its assumptions and its limits, and how it was checked.

about.title: About
about.whatBody: A market-information service for Sri Lankan investors: data from public sources, the methods applied to it, and the limits of both. It offers information, tools and education only.
about.sourcesBody: Share prices, indices and market statistics: Colombo Stock Exchange. Government bond quotes, trades, volumes and auctions: Public Debt Management Office, Ministry of Finance. Data is used only where the source's terms allow it.
about.tiersBody: Most of the site is free. Some analysis will be part of paid tiers (Plus, Pro, Professional) once accounts open. The tier rules are applied on our server: information outside your tier is never sent to your browser.
about.correctionsBody: Sources are stored exactly as published, and every calculation is versioned. When a source corrects a figure, the correction is applied and the earlier value is kept on record.

bond_identity.title: Government bond list and daily quotes
bond_identity.summary: Every LKR treasury bond the PDMO publishes a dealer quote for, with each day's average bid and offer yields and prices.

bond_ns_curve.title: LKR government bond yield curve
bond_ns_curve.summary: A Nelson-Siegel curve fitted each day to dealer quotes, and how far each bond's yield sits above or below it.

bond_liquidity.title: Bond trading activity
bond_liquidity.summary: How much each bond has traded over the last 60 days, when it was last auctioned, and its trading-activity tier.

bond_rv_zscores.title: Bond residuals against their own history
bond_rv_zscores.summary: Each bond's distance from the curve, and the spread between neighbouring bonds, compared with their own recent range.

bond_execution_gap.title: Trades against quotes
bond_execution_gap.summary: How far executed trades have printed from the dealers' quoted mid yields over the last 20 days.

bond_carry.title: Carry, rolldown and duration
bond_carry.summary: Each bond's yield over a stated funding rate, its rolldown along an unchanged curve, and both per unit of duration.

cse_market_tape.title: CSE market summary
cse_market_tape.summary: Index levels and changes, turnover against its 20-session average, breadth, and foreign flows for each session.

cse_security_metrics.title: CSE share metrics
cse_security_metrics.summary: For every listed share and session: price change, position in its 52-week range, volume against average, and return relative to the ASPI.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: This page could not be loaded. Please try again in a few minutes.
